assertions.description: Artefact completeness: every entry in expected_artefacts exists, its hash matches the run manifest, and the licence ledger covers 100% of assets.
assertions.expected: all expected artefacts present; licence_ledger coverage == 100%

assertions.description: DAG correctness: no agent starts before its dependencies are DONE; QC (32), Copyright (33) and Policy/Similarity (34) gates must all PASS before the Upload fake is callable.
assertions.expected: pipeline order respected; upload callable only after gates 32/33/34 == PASS

assertions.description: Gate refusal of out-of-order upload: the harness attempts to invoke the upload stage before the gate agents have passed.
assertions.expected: upload attempt is refused with an explicit gate error; zero videos.insert calls recorded

assertions.description: Idempotency: upload stage run twice with the same idempotency key hash(file+channel+title).
assertions.expected: fake YouTube records exactly one (single) videos.insert per idempotency key

assertions.description: Quota-ledger math: the fixture run's ledger entries sum to the hand-computed bucket usage (uploads bucket, search bucket, shared units) for this fixture; the scheduler defers rather than overflowing a near-empty bucket.
assertions.expected: ledger totals == hand-computed totals in this manifest; no bucket goes negative or overflows

assertions.description: Checkpoint/resume: if the harness kills the sidecar and restarts, completed PAID steps are never re-executed (fake-provider call counts asserted).
assertions.expected: fake-provider call counts for completed paid steps do not increase on resume

assertions.description: Determinism boundary: with fakes and temperature 0, two runs of this fixture produce identical scene lists, subtitle timings within +/-100 ms, and identical QC verdicts (pixel/audio identity is the golden-video suite's job, not this layer's).
assertions.expected: scene lists identical; subtitle timing delta <= 100 ms; QC verdicts identical

assertions.description: With stock fakes returning nothing, the AI-image fallback fires for every scene and each generated asset is entered in the licence/provenance ledger as AI-generated.
assertions.expected: ai_image_fallback_invocations == scene count; every scene asset has a ledger row marked AI-generated

assertions.description: No scene is left empty/placeholder because stock was missing; an empty scene shipped would be a QC must-fail (see fault corpus).
assertions.expected: zero scenes without an asset; QC verdict == PASS
